Ordway Leadership
Building software users actually love
Founder and CEO
Sameer Gulati
After having launched several billion-dollar finance applications at some of the world’s leading ERP companies, Sameer Gulati founded Ordway in 2018 with the vision of building a more flexible billing and revenue automation platform. He wanted to free customers from the constraints that many of the incumbent, rigid financial systems suffered. Over the past few years, Sameer has led Ordway through a period of rapid growth and outside investment as the company has begun to disrupt the recurring billing and subscription management category.
Full Bio
Senior Vice President of R&D and Operations
Subbu Venkiteswaran
As Senior Vice President of R&D and Operations, Subbu Venkiteswaran has responsibility for the research and development, product engineering, operations, security, and compliance functions at Ordway. His team manages the product development lifecycle for Ordway’s solutions. His team is responsible for the innovation behind the Ordway billing and rating engine, revenue sub-ledger, and dynamic product catalog as well as platform features such as workflow, analytics, and integration.
Full Bio
Chief Marketing Officer
Steve Keifer
As Chief Marketing Officer, Steve Keifer has responsibility for Ordway’s growth strategy, demand generation, and brand development programs, which are designed to expand the company’s market share in the SaaS, cloud, fintech, AI, and IoT segments. Additionally, he has responsibility for Ordway’s research practice which publishes thought leadership studies on pricing strategies, subscription management, and billing strategies for recurring revenue business models.
Full Bio
Vice President of Client Services
Max Rosenberg
As Vice President of Client Services, Max Rosenberg oversees all new implementations as well as the customer success and professional services teams.  His team works closely with finance directors, controllers, and revenue operations professionals at hundreds of SaaS and cloud companies to optimize their subscription billing, revenue recognition, accounts receivable, and investor metrics reporting.
Vice President of Sales
Mike Miele
As Vice President of Sales, Mike has responsibility for new customer acquisition through both direct sales an d indirect channels such as ERP software vendors, financial advisory firms, and fractional CFO consultancies.  His team works with finance, accounting, revenue operations, and customer success teams to design solutions that optimize their recurring billing, revenue accounting, and investor metrics reporting.  Mike’s team includes account executives charged with building new relationships, sales engineers responsible for technical solution design, and partnership managers that establish new referral and reseller channels.
Ordway Subscription Billing Software 
Ordway’s all-in-one platform combines Subscription Invoicing Software, SaaS accounting software, Recurring Billing Software, and SaaS Billing & Metered Billing Software to automate complex pricing models, streamline revenue recognition, and accelerate financial close for growing SaaS companies.
